facts_verified.claim: The runtime now performs a two-phase fifteen-slot R2 inventory before provider DNS or secret access, replays durable captures despite later local failures, and invokes provider access lazily only for an eligible missing slot.

Quota and failure continuity are conservative across dispatches: verified quota survives invalid-payload replay, replay quota is not treated as a current live sequence, low quota stops before any new call, and two proven identical durable failures forbid a third attempt while ambiguous reservations do not.

The R2 bound is derived from the concrete path: fifteen reservation GETs, at most fifteen raw/recheck GETs, three cycle receipts and one terminal report, for a maximum of 34 exact reads per dispatch and 102 across the three authorized dispatches.

The workflow remains an exact-merged-main manual gate, reuses existing provider and R2 secrets, provides a 30-minute operational timeout for three cycles separated by 120 seconds, and publishes only normalized artifacts for fourteen days.

Independent adversarial review reports P0=0 and P1=0 after 101 capture tests, 65 transport tests, focused inventory/workflow/CLI tests, Ruff and strict mypy, all with zero unapproved network attempts.
